result.title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
result.summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MedJev，在裁剪掉上层语言层与生成通路的 VLM 主干上，保留完整视觉通路与视觉 token，用预训练 query–key 匹配加轻量 MLP 残差对候选答案打分，单次前向直接给出医学图像理解决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 「不做自回归生成、直接从多模态内部状态读答案」的做法，可供核查 latent 表示是否已足够支撑决策，以及生成式解码中的信息坍缩问题；但该文属效率导向的判别式分类，无推理状态更新与证据筛选，联系仅为方法线索。
